title: Text2Tradition: From Epistemological Tensions to AI-Mediated Cross-Cultural Co-Creation

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative exploration of epistemological tensions and Western-centric biases by prompting an LLM (GPT-4o) to translate contemporary and Western narratives (e.g., Star Wars) into a non-Western cultural framework (traditional Thai classical dance sequences) and analyzing the resulting cross-cultural metaphors and interpretations.
